results.content: # Trump approval sinks to new low in Fox News poll. President Donald Trump's approval rating has fallen to a new low in Fox News polling, as voters express deep dissatisfaction with his handling of inflation and the economy and Democrats widen their advantage ahead of November's midterm elections. The survey, released Oct. 14, found Trump's approval rating at 36%, while 64% of registered voters said they disapproved of his job performance. According to Fox News, that marks the lowest approval rating the president has received in the network's polling during either of his two terms in the White House. According to the poll, 77% of voters disapproved of Trump's handling of inflation. Fox News

results.content: With highly contested midterm elections in a few weeks, President Donald Trump again sees his approval rating stuck at a career-low in Reuters/Ipsos polling, which also indicated cratering support from Hispanic voters. Trump’s current approval rating, which has now sat at 32% in two consecutive polls, is the lowest he has seen in Reuters/Ipsos polling during both terms in office. results.content: With the midterm elections just weeks away, new polls show the president facing some of the weakest approval ratings of his political career, raising fresh questions about whether the GOP can hold onto its narrow congressional majorities. A string of surveys released over the past week has found his approval rating stuck in the upper 30s, while major polling averages show more Americans disapprove of his job performance than approve of it. According to a new AP-NORC poll released last week, 65% of Americans said they blamed the president's policies for increasing costs.
